claims.statement: Tom Allen and Ben Hogan were to fight in October 1873, but the planned excursion to the fight was stopped by Illinois sheriffs on October 20, 1873.
claims.excerpt: between Tom Allen and Ben Hogan, in 1873

claims.statement: John Looney suspected that Ben Hogan had arranged the failed excursion as a put-up job to avoid meeting Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: he suspected that it wasa ‘‘put up ye on the pan of Ben Hogan to avoid meeting

fights.excerpt: between Tom Allen and Ben Hogan, in 1873
fights.notes: The bout never took place. The 1877 article is about a lawsuit over the chartered steamer Continental; Allen was not a party to it.

notes: Lawsuit by Capt. John McCloy against John Looney over the steamer damage is not a Tom Allen fact.
